visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two hands hold a round, quilted pink YSL cushion foundation and a square purple Clio cushion foundation against a white textured background. White bold text at the top reads "Makeup Dupes You Need to Know!!!". Below, the prices NT$2980 and NT$1150 are displayed alongside the specific product names. A woman then appears in a medium shot, holding these same items near her face. She has neutral-toned makeup, dark hair, and wears a navy blue collared shirt. Her facial expression is calm and confident. (2) The scene transitions to a close-up of hands holding two tubes of makeup primer: a white tube from Make Up For Ever and a nude-colored tube from mude. Text overlays show NT$1650 and NT$590. The woman is then shown holding both tubes, one in each hand, framing her face. She is positioned in front of a white shelf filled with high-end cosmetic boxes. Her skin appears luminous under the bright studio lighting. (3) The video cuts to hands holding two open blush compacts: a circular black Giorgio Armani blush and a square transparent essence blush. The shades are both peachy-pink. Text indicates prices of NT$1800 and NT$89. The woman then holds both blushes up, smiling slightly. Her jewelry, a Dior pendant necklace and small hoop earrings, is clearly visible. The background remains the same organized shelf. (4) A pair of hands displays two liquid lip products in clear tubes with pink gloss inside: Dior Addict Lip Maximizer and VISEE Lip Plumper. The price comparison shows NT$1380 versus NT$330. The woman returns to the frame, holding both products near her cheeks. She looks directly into the lens, showcasing the products effectively for her audience. The visual rhythm is fast and energetic. (5) In the final segment, hands hold two slim lipstick tubes: a black and gold Tom Ford lipstick and a slender silver Kiss lipstick. Prices are NT$1680 and approximately NT$415. The woman holds these products, concluding the sequence of "dupes." The lighting remains consistent, highlighting the texture of the lipsticks. The overall aesthetic is clean, professional, and typical of beauty influencer content on social media.
